answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a vault before it can trade: the bond is released only after a history of verified work, and any proven fake identity forfeits it. A sybil farmer must fund a separate deposit for each clone, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents pay nothing beyond one deposit. Like an ivory registry checking each tusk, or a tundra outpost admitting one verified traveler per pass, the registry ties each bond to one operator, making mass fakery expensive and unprofitable.
